hero.lead: I'm Romain Piau. I build desktop apps, developer tools and Minecraft projects, from the first idea all the way to production.

mm.desc: Installs Minecraft modpacks published on GitHub straight into CurseForge in one click, and updates them without losing worlds or settings. A built-in Studio helps authors publish to GitHub, CurseForge, Modrinth and Hangar.

cv.desc: One master résumé, variants in one click: each version hides what isn't needed. Drag-and-drop visual editor, animations, light / dark mode, PDF or HTML export and publishing to GitHub.

uc.desc: The Undercover party game on iPhone, inside the Scriptable app: roles sent by text message, a leaderboard saved to iCloud and custom word lists, all in a single native interface.
